Commentary.Commentary: Blanked 3-0 in the Tests, pipped 3-2 in the ODIs and beaten 2-1 in the T20Is. The Pakistan team fought hard in the white ball leg but they head home without any silverware. South Africa would definitely be pleased with this performance and will be looking forward to the Tests at home against Sri Lanka coming up. Thus, a pretty long tour consisting all the formats comes to an end and we saw the visitors being outplayed. Hope you enjoyed the coverage as much as we enjoyed bringing it to you. Take care and cheers!

David Miller, the captain of the South African team is also the Man of the Series. He is happy that the Proteas came out and showed their class in all three formats. Says that he enjoyed captaining the side in the T20Is,  and thanks his teammates for supporting him and helping him all the way. Applauds the people who got the chance and put their hand up to beat the number 1 side in the world. Reckons that the Pakistani bowling attack is one of the best in the world but it was great the way they played them and got to the victory. He now walks over to collect the trophy and calls over his teammates for the shutterbugs. Lots of smiles around and South Africa must be really pleased by the performance in all 3 formats in this long drawn-out tour.

Shadab Khan is the Man of the Match for his all-round performance tonight. Feels that it was a plan to just wait for the last over and then smash how much ever is possible in it. Mentions it was a great tour for them and a lovely learning curve for all of the youngsters. Reckons it was good to come out of the comfort zone of UAE and then bowl here where he did not find it so easy.

Shoaib Malik, Pakistan's captain is happy with the win and says that it is good that there are some smiling faces at the end of the night. Feels that they were good in the white ball leg of the tour but concedes that they need to be better in the crunch situations. Reckons that they could have won the series but feels that what is important is to learn from this and come back and do better if they are in the same position again. Praises Shaheen Afridi and mentions that he is talented but needs to continue learning and improve day by day. Laughs slightly when he is asked as to how Pakistan unearth fast bowlers all the time but mentions that it is good for his country, also puts a lot of praise on Babar Azam and Imam-ul-Haq as well. Continues to say that it was a good learning curve for them and mentions it is important to play well abroad. Signs off by congratulating the South African team for winning all 3 series.

South Africa were maybe complacent. Had a very bad Powerplay and then the pressure got the better of them. Miller, Rassie didn't find the gaps and left Morris with too much to do. Earlier on in the evening, the hosts had Pakistan well under control but a final burst from Shadab Khan ensured Pakistan get to 168. It proved to be the difference in the end. Stay tuned for the final presentation of the tour.

The visitors started well picking up two early wickets in the Powerplay. That pegged the hosts back. They then got the big wickets of Klaasen, Miller and Rassie at regular intervals stopping the flow of runs. Morris got to his maiden T20I fifty but was left with plenty to get in the end. Imad bowled 4 overs at a stretch and was brilliant. Amir got 3 while Shaheen gave him good company. All the bowlers got a wicket with Shadab and Ashraf bagging a brace.

What a win for Pakistan. They manage to comfortably by 27 runs in the end. After the first innings, majority thought that 168 was below par but they have bowled out of their skin and defended this target.

A perfect yorker to end the match and the tour, kept out towards point by Morris. Afridi ends a super night for him with the ball having figures of 4-0-23-1 and Pakistan will be smiling at least with the result tonight. THEY WIN THIS GAME BY 27 RUNS BUT THE SERIES IS TAKEN BY SOUTH AFRICA 2-1.
SIX! Too little too late but nonetheless a fifty for Morris. His first in T20Is. A length ball on the pads, flicked away and the ball goes deep into the crowd at the mid-wicket region.
SIX! One away from the fifty now. A length ball on the middle stump line, Morris stands tall and swings this away over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Leading edge and the full length ball on the pads flies to deep point on the bounce. The single is not taken. Morris wants a 50 here it seems.
Slower ball angles across Morris who swings but connects with thin air.
DROPPED! Short ball over the stumps, Morris goes for the pull but gets a top edge to it. Afridi goes for it himself but puts it down.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl out.
Yorker on the pads, worked away to fine leg but the single is not taken. 40 runs needed off 6 balls now. Faheem after one 21-run over ends with figures of 4-0-38-2.
Tabraiz Shamsi is the last man in.
OUT! Disturbs the stumps! A fuller length ball on middle and too good for the number 10 bat. Sipamla looks to flick it away but misses. Ashraf hits and South Africa just have one wicket left now.
Another excellent yorker, too good from Faheem. Morris takes a single by keeping it out towards point.
Length ball on the pads, front-arm pull away from deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Brilliant comeback from Ashraf. Yorker right at Morris' toes and he can only jam it out to point. Dot ball.
FOUR! Smashed back over the bowler's head. A half-volley outside off, Morris swings through the line and hits it over the head of Faheem. No chance for long off to come around there.
Fuller outisde off, driven back to deep cover for a single by Morris. End of another good over from Amir. He ends with 3/27 off his 4 overs.
Lutho Sipamla is in at no. 10.

OUT! Dala holes out and South Africa look all but lost here. A length ball just outside off and Junior connects on his slog this time. It goes very high but not too far. Hasan Ali, on as a sub comes under it at deep square leg and takes a beautiful catch under the lights. The crowd have gone silent here.
A length ball outside off, Dala goes for the swing but fails to put bat on ball.
Fuller length ball on the pads, Morris looks to drive it but it goes off the inside edge and to the leg side for a single. Morris gets off strike.
FOUR! Full toss on the pads and this time it is helped on its way to the deep backward square leg for a boundary. South Africa need many more of these.
Swing and a miss! A length ball on top of off stump, Morris takes his eyes off the ball and looks to smash it but misses the radar completely.
Brilliant running from Morris. A yorker length ball on the leg stump, Dala jams it away to mid-wicket. His partner runs really hard and gets back home in time.
The change of bats does not seem to have done anything. Another mistimed shot towards long on and this one goes on a bounce to the fielder. Single taken.
Good yorker! Junior can just keep it out towards short fine and gets to the other end.
Morris does not get this one on the middle of the bat as well. It goes to long on all along the ground for a single. Looks frustrated as he was running through. Signals for another bat.
Quicker one on the middle stump line, Dala manages to play it to long on and gets to the other end.
Low full toss outside off, Morris mistimes his hit towards long off on one bounce. Gets off strike, more importantly, for Pakistan.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl now.
Left alone outside off to end the over. Excellent over from Amir, a wicket and just 3 runs off it in the end.
Well bowled! Keeps the ball out of the swinging arc of Morris and all Chris can do is to hit it down the ground to long off for a single.
Full toss outside off and pushed away to the cover region for a single. Gets Morris back on strike.
Junior Dala walks in at number 9.

OUT! Timberrrrr! A yorker, right at the base of the stumps. Too good for Hendricks to keep it out. Amir is delighted and so are all of the Pakistan supporters. South Africa now need 62 runs off 27 balls.
Slower ball read by Beuran this time and he defends it back to the bowler.
A fuller length ball outside off, driven hard to deep cover for a single by Morris. Pakistan will not mind this.
Mohammad Amir is back to bowl.
Hurled in really quick this time on the pads, BH misses his flick and it ends as a dot ball. 63 runs required off 30 balls now. Shadab ends with figures of 4-0-34-2.
A flatter one bowled well outside off by Shadab, Hendricks drives it away wide of long off for a couple of runs.
Bowled well down the off side and Beuran can't reach the ball. Dot ball.
Morris comes down the track and looks to smash this one over long on for a biggie but only gets a bottom edge that runs down the ground for a single to the deep fielder.
Hendricks flicks this one on the pads away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside edge to this flatter one outside off. Short third man comes in and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Would have been really close had he hit.
A single off the last ball of the over and Morris keeps strike as he drives this to deep cover.
FOUR! Another boundary here! Faheem does not know what to do. A length ball outside off, carved over point for a boundary. 20 off the over so far.

FOUR! Oh my god! There was no need for Hasan Ali to come in once he knew he could not catch that one. A fuller length ball, Morris went for the slog but there was a mistimed shot to the left of mid-wicket. Hasan, who is on as a sub for Imad goes for the catch but fails to even stop the ball and lets it through for a boundary. South Africa turning on the heat in this over.
SIX! 2,4,6. Morris knows his even numbers and makes sure Faheem does too. A short length ball on middle and Chris just pulls it way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Full toss this time and hit to the left of extra cover now. Beats him and deep cover as well. Amazing time!
Sounded really good off the bat as Morris drives this fuller length ball wide of extra cover for a couple of runs.
Beuran Hendricks to join Morris in the middle.

OUT! Three reds and Phehlukwayo is a goner. Full again this time on leg. Once again Andile looks to reverse sweep it but misses. The ball goes on to hit his legs. Pakistan appeal and the umpire obliges. South Africa take the review but it doesn't help their cause. They lose the review as well as their 6th wicket.
Review time... Andile has been given LBW here, but has reviewed it. Looks to be out and the review seems one to be done out of desperation by South Africa here.
Outside off, Andile looks to reverse sweep but can't make any contact.

FOUR! Two men were colliding but no damage done. Fuller ball on off, Andile lofts this over the bowler's head. The men from long on and long off try to get under it. In the end, it goes through the hands of Afridi and bounces just before the ropes for a boundary.
Leg spinner outside off, cut past the point region for one more. Single won't hurt Pakistan.
A bit short on off, cut towards cover-point for one.
Loopy ball on leg, swept to short fine leg for a single.
Brilliant from Faheem. His first over and it just goes for 3 runs with a wicket. Around off, Andile punches it to the off side.
Wide! Errs down leg, wide given by the umpire.
Back of a length ball on leg, Andile misses his flick and the ball does near him.
Outside off, cut to point.
Chris Morris walks in next.

OUT! The man who could guide South Africa to victory is out of here. Low full toss on off, Rassie looks to go big but he too gets a top edge while his bat turns in his hand. This one flies towards mid off where Malik comes running in and takes a diving catch forward. The dangerous Rassie walks back the home side lose half of the batting.
Back of a length ball around off, Andile cuts it to third man and rotates strike.
Comes in from over the wicket and angles this into the pads. Rassie flicks it through square leg and wanted the second but is sent back.
Faheem Ashraf to bowl now.
Andile comes down the track and decides to block it.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Tossed up on off, Andile gets on one knee and swipes this through mid-wicket and gets himself a boundary.
The next man in is Andile Phehlukwayo.

OUT! The big wicket, Miller is out of here! Wrong 'un on off, Miller gets low to sweep but gets a top edge to it. The ball lobs behind Shadab who tracks back and takes a simple catch. The big fish and the game changer is back in the hut. SA need 103 runs in 56 balls at 11.03 rpo.
Driven through mid off by Rassie. They pick up a single.
SIX! HUGE! Gets hold of it. Loopy ball on middle and leg, Rassie gives the charge and clobbers this over long on for a huge, huge hit. Needs more of this.
Leg spinner on middle, Rassie steps out but blocks it.
Looks like Miler has caught his muscle after that run. The physio is out and giving him some treatment.

NOT OUT! David Miller is just in. Huge cheer from the crowd. A length ball outside off, driven wide of deep cover by the southpaw and he decides to come back for the second pretty late. The throw goes to the bowler's end where Amir collects the ball and then hurls it towards the keeper's end. Scores a direct hit. The umpire at square leg takes it upstairs where replays show that the batsman is safe. South Africa are 59/3 at the end of 10 overs. They need 110 runs in 60 balls now.
Run out? Is David Miller short? Could be a huge blow to the hosts!
This time the fuller length ball is pushed wide of cover for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Rassie looks to drive it to cover.
Wide! Sprayed way wide of the off stump. The batsman chases it but it is very far to even get there. Umpire signals the wide as well.

Unnecessary from Pakistan! A length ball outside off, pushed to point by the southpaw. Miller looks for a single but is sent back by Rassie who turns back and gets in his crease. Shadab at point has a shy at the bowler's end that was not required and an overthrow is taken.

Ooh! Would have been tight had he hit. A length ball outside off, punched to cover and van der Dussen sets off. The cover fielder picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses the stump. Single completed.
Length ball outside off, angled away wide of point for a couple of runs by van der Dussen. South Africa getting some momentum here.
Fuller length this time and Rassie guides it all along the ground to long on once more for a run. 11 runs off this over.
Another single, this time from Miller down to long on. The 50 comes up for the hosts.
Flatter one outside off, pushed back down to long off for a single. Good batting following the maximum.

SIX! 'He is charging at you' says the keeper before the ball was bowled and van der Dussen does exactly the same this time as well. He comes down the ground to a flighted delivery outside off and lifts it high and well over the long off fielder. Shadab has a weird and puzzled look on his face.
Quicker one on middle and leg, driven down to long on by DM for a single.
Flatter one outside off, pushed away wide of long on for a single by the right-hander.
Shadab Khan replaces Imad Wasim.

FOUR! That went like a tracer bullet. A short of a length ball outside off, Miller just stands tall and times this so well through point. Reaches the rope and the deep cover fielder had no chance there.
Wide! Another slower one but it is down the leg side this time. Given wide.
Slower ball outside off, David is beaten by the pace this time and plays a false shot outside off. Fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! Shot! On the pads this time from Amir, Miller just uses his wrists and flicks this one away through mid-wicket with excellent timing. It was slightly uppish but no fielder there meant it was a safe and good shot.
Beauty! Not the first ball you want to face. A length ball outside off, Miller looks to push it on the off side but fails to put bat on ball as he is beaten on the outside.
Fuller length ball outside off, pushed with soft hands towards mid off by Rassie and a single is stolen.
South Africa's captain David Miller is the new man in. Can he rescue his side?

OUT! Amir strikes first ball. Klaasen has to go and South Africa struggling big time here. Short of a length outside off from Amir to start, Heinrich looks to pull it away but the ball goes off the top edge and straight up. Goes to mid off where Malik takes the simplest of catches. The uncomfortable 10-ball stay for Klaasen comes to an end. Pakistan on fire now, the hosts need 139 off 77 balls.
Mohammad Amir is into the attack.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. They pick up a single. Just 6 runs from the over. Imad finishes off with figures of 4-0-19-1.
Fires this on middle and leg, Heinrich on-drives it towards mid on. Dot ball.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Full again on the leg side, flicked away around the corner. Shadab cannot collect the ball and throw it in one motion which enables them to get back for the second.
Darts this on middle, Rassie cannot get it past cover-point.
Fuller ball on the legs of Klassen who flicks it away through mid-wicket to give his partner the strike.

Another play and a miss! Surely the blow would have rattled him. This time a slower ball outside off and Rassie was caught on the crease as he looked to drive. Hence, misses the ball and South Africa end the Powerplay at 24/2. Pakistan on top here, the hosts need 145 in 84 balls now.
The physio is come out to have a check on Rassie. He looks fine.

OUCH! That must have hurt. A bouncer from Afridi, van der Dussen looks to pull but the extra bounce causes the ball to go off the glove and onto the grill. Looks to be rattled and the Pakistan players come to ask him if he is alright. Good thinking from Shaheen though to bowl the short ball now.
Great comeback from Shaheen. A length ball outside off, Rassie looks to run it down to third man but is beaten by the very slight away movement.
FOUR! Gets a good bit of willow there! A length ball outside off, van der Dussen stands tall and swings it over mid on. Goes over the rope on one bounce.
Slower ball this time and Rassie has no idea about the change. Misses his shot as he looks to adjust and guide it down to third man in the end.
Very full outside off, vd Dussen jams the ball out back down the ground.
Excellent over. Full around off, Klaasen taps it to the off side.
Dot ball. Just 3 runs off the over so far. Fired in at 99kph on off, Klaasen drives it to mid off.
Rassie has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Misfield and get a double. Similar ball on leg, Rassie punches it towards Faheem at mid off. He cannot collect the ball and it rolls further back. They come back for the second.
On middle and leg again, Rassie gives room and punches it this time towards mid off.
Darts this on  middle and leg, played to short mid-wicket.
Another dot ball to end the over. This one is played away to the cover region once more by the keeper-bat. Just 3 runs off that over! Brilliant stuff from Pakistan.
Outside off on a good length, Heinrich pushes it towards cover.

Peach! A length ball on off and slightly shaping away. Klaasen looks to run it down to third man but the ball moves away a bit and beats his outside edge in the end. There is a huge appeal from the bowler and the keeper but there was nothing on the ball. They do not take it upstairs. Replays show that it was a good decision.
Outside off this time, left alone by Klaasen.

Just a little too far! A length ball on middle, Rassie lifts it high but not too far. The ball flies over mid on where Amir tries to run back and take that one with outstretched arms but the ball is just a bit too far away from him in the end. Three runs are taken by the batsmen till the ball returns. That is good running.
A fuller length ball outside off, VDD drives to mid off but no run is available.
Heinrich Klaasen is the next batsman.

OUT! Bowled 'em! South Africa under a bit of pressure now. An arm ball on off stump line and just comes in slightly with the angle. Malan plays well away from the body and tries to push it straight but the ball goes in between bat and pad. Disturbs the stumps and the South Africa crowd as well. Pakistan surely in the game here.
Imad running through his overs here. Faster one on middle, Malan pushes it back down the ground.
Rassie flat-bats this down the ground to long on and gets to the other end.
Another one quick and pushed in on leg stump, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one on middle, pushed back to long on for a single by van der Dussen.
Wide! Wasim hurls this one down the leg side. Rassie loses balance as he was trying to flick but his foot was grounded so the wicket-keeper removing the bails was not an issue there.
Flatter one on middle, Malan looks to push it to long on but the ball takes the inside edge and a single has been taken. He is off the mark.
Around off, pushed to the off side. A wicket and four runs from this.
FOUR! SHOT! Misses his yorker and darts a half-volley on middle, Rassie just punches it along the turf past the bowler for a boundary.
Lovely from Afridi. Fuller and on the stumps. Rassie jams it out towards mid on.
Length on off, Rassie gets behind it and blocks it out.
Rassie van der Dussen is in at number 3.

OUT! Afridi gets the first blow. Just the start they needed. Another similar ball, back of a length, Hendricks looks to tuck it away but the ball nips in. He closes the bat face and gets a soft leading edge which goes back towards the bowler who takes a simple catch and celebrates.
Back of a length ball on the legs on Reeza. He shuffles and looks to flick it away but misses. Afridi appeals but the umpire stays unmoved.
Arm ball on middle and going straight on, Malan pushes towards mid on. A great comeback from Imad after being hit for four on the first ball.
Almost gone first ball! A flatter one outside off, Malan looks to cut but the ball almost snuck through. The bat came down just in the nick of time.
Shortens the length once more, punched back down the ground to long by RH for a single.
A push towards mid off, extra cover is beaten on the dive but the batsmen were never in a mood for the single there.
A flatter one outside off, defended back down the ground this time by Reeza.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, cut away through backward point for a boundary by Hendricks. The hosts are up and away.
We are back for the chase. Reeza Hendricks and Janneman Malan are the opening batsmen for the hosts. Imad Wasim to bowl the first over.
